ns2:course.label: Design for Responsible Innovation Research Impact
ns2:course.description: This seminar helps DRI graduate students connect their research with pedagogy and professional development strategies to disseminate their research into publishing, conferences, communities, and other relevant venues. Students may take this course one time for credit toward the MFA DRI degree and one time for credit toward the PhD DRI degree. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 8 hours.
